author: Albert Mulder
releaseNotes:
2.1.0 (all components) - Code-audit fixes. Listener: motion/occupancy no longer get stuck active, the last reading of a burst is no longer dropped, and per-message bookkeeping moved out of state (much lower hub load); brightness/color updates are rate-limited too; reconnects back off; the broker password is no longer stored in device state; probing restores the nightlight. App: fixed the update queue stalling and losing updates; re-running setup no longer stamps 'pending' on existing devices or deletes existing devices that didn't answer the probe. Pro/Aura: added the Switch capability - on/off controls the nightlight/color light (never the outlets), so these devices now also appear as switches in switch pickers, groups and voice assistants; Aura no longer lists Pro-only sensors (motion, presence, air quality, distance). Debug logging left on by older versions turns itself off 30 minutes after the update. No re-pairing needed.
2.0.3 (MQTT Listener) - Fixed unbounded state growth from tracking topics of non-InvisOutlet devices on a shared broker.
